title: Enhancing cryopreservation of human induced pluripotent stem cells: Bottom-up versus conventional freezing geometry.
cell_types: engineered WTC11 human iPSC line with doxycycline-inducible Ngn2
study_design: Primary study comparing bottom-up controlled ice nucleation/freezing with conventional radial freezing in cryovials and 30 mL bags.

experiments.intervention: Bottom-up freezing with 5% DMSO, 90 s bottom ice nucleation, and controlled cooling at −1, −2, or −3 °C/min
experiments.cooling: Bottom-up −1, −2, or −3 °C/min from −5 to −80 °C; conventional nominal −1 °C/min
experiments.storage: −80 °C; methods describe 72 h after freezing while results describe 2 days, an internal inconsistency
experiments.outcome_name: Post-thaw membrane integrity and cell reducing-power metabolic assay
experiments.timepoint: After thaw; metabolic assay after 24 h adherent culture
experiments.result: At 5% DMSO and 90 s nucleation, bottom-up cooling at −2 °C/min was the selected optimization condition; reported average viability was 87% by membrane integrity and 62% by reducing power. The 1% DMSO condition showed a membrane-integrity increase from 5% to 20% with bottom-up geometry, while metabolic state was not significantly improved.
experiments.sample_size: Three cryovials per geometry in the described parameter experiments; authors call independently frozen vials biological replicates, but these are not independent donors; plated wells are technical replicates.
experiments.source_locator: geometry-methods-indexed.txt, iPSCs freezing; geometry-results-indexed.txt, DMSO, nucleation-time, and cooling-rate sections
experiments.evidence_excerpt: Average cell viability was 46% for 60 s nucleation time

experiments.model: Engineered WTC11 human iPSCs in 30 mL cryobags
experiments.intervention: Bottom-up freezing with 5% DMSO, 90 s nucleation, and −2 °C/min cooling
experiments.comparator: 30 mL bag placed directly into −80 °C freezer; passive cooling rate unknown
experiments.cooling: Bottom-up −2 °C/min from −5 to −80 °C; passive bag comparator rate not reported
experiments.storage: −80 °C; duration described inconsistently as 72 h in methods and 2 days in results
experiments.outcome_name: Post-thaw membrane integrity and cell reducing-power metabolic assay
experiments.result: In 30 mL bags, bottom-up versus conventional values were 69% versus 60% by membrane integrity and 31% versus 23% by reducing power. The passive −80 °C comparator prevents isolating geometry from its unreported thermal history.
experiments.sample_size: Bag/donor replication count not established from the inspected passages; no independent donor replication established.
experiments.source_locator: geometry-methods-indexed.txt, Scale-up of iPSC freezing; geometry-results-indexed.txt, Scale-up section

experiments.model: Engineered WTC11 human iPSCs differentiated into neurons
experiments.intervention: Neuronal differentiation after bottom-up or conventional freezing
experiments.comparator: Alternate freezing geometries and tested DMSO conditions; do not infer a separate unfrozen control from the inspected text
experiments.outcome_name: Neuronal morphogenesis: terminal branch length and branch-node number
experiments.result: Neuronal differentiation pace and degree were similar after the compared freezing geometries and tested DMSO conditions. The indexed manuscript reports morphology measures only; electrophysiology was not reported in this experiment.
experiments.sample_size: Replicate count not established from the inspected passages; no independent donor replication established.
experiments.source_locator: geometry-methods-indexed.txt, iPSCs differentiation into neurons; geometry-results-indexed.txt, iPSC differentiation into neurons
experiments.evidence_excerpt: not affected by different cooling rates

main_finding: In this engineered WTC11 iPSC model, bottom-up controlled nucleation/freezing improved selected post-thaw viability measures under optimized conditions and retained a scale-up advantage, while neuronal morphology through day 8 was similar across freezing geometries.
limitations: Institutionally deposited manuscript text was used; journal version was not verified in detail.
Technical cryovials, wells, and bags are not independent donor replicates.
Passive bag comparator cooling rate was not reported, so geometry cannot be isolated.
Methods state 72 h storage while results state 2 days.
No electrophysiology result was reported for neuronal differentiation.
One engineered WTC11 line with inducible Ngn2; forced neuronal differentiation limits generalization.
Membrane integrity is a live-cell fraction and PrestoBlue is a metabolic signal after 24 h plating plus 4 h reagent incubation; neither establishes absolute viable-cell yield.
Absolute bag outcomes were lower than optimized vial outcomes despite a relative bottom-up advantage.
The described 5% DMSO formulation also contains 50% KnockOut Serum Replacement and 10 µM Y-27632; geometry effects cannot be generalized without the full medium/recovery context.
mechanism_claim: The study directly compares freezing geometry, cooling, nucleation, and post-thaw assays; reduced mechanical/ice stress is a protocol interpretation, not direct proof of a specific intracellular mechanism.
reviewer: Luna extraction; root indexed institutional manuscript methods/results review
source_version: Selected text from an institutional manuscript; exact agreement with the published journal version has not been established
